title: Universal Weather Node — device description (/api/info)
description: What this node is and what /api/data will contain: read it once at start-up (and again after the node restarted, i.e. device.uptimeSec went down) to build your UI. Contains no secrets (no passwords, keys, station IDs, broker or coordinates). Stability: within apiVersion 1 fields are only added.

apiVersion.description: API contract version (1). Check it first: refuse or warn on an unknown major version.

ui.description: Web UI options of the node's own dashboard (Settings → System → Web UI). The dashboard reads them once at load; another UI may ignore them.

flashOnChange.description: Dashboard tiles briefly highlight when their value changes.

showAge.description: Dashboard tiles show how long ago their value was received.

system.description: Uptime and memory, for watching a node over days (a steadily falling heapMin or heapLargest points to a leak or fragmentation).

uptimeSec.description: Seconds since the last start (same as device.uptimeSec).

heapFree.description: Free internal RAM now (8-bit capable; a PSRAM is counted separately in psram).

heapMin.description: Lowest free internal RAM since start.

heapLargest.description: Largest free block of internal RAM now. Without PSRAM, HTTPS needs a 24 KB block and 70 KB free; with PSRAM its large buffers go there.

psram.x-present: PSRAM found and in use (Heltec V4)
psram.description: PSRAM in the heap (Heltec V4: 2 MB in the chip). Buffers of 4 KB and more (history, wind window, radio trace, TLS, Wi-Fi) prefer it. Left out on a board without PSRAM, or if it did not start - the status page and the boot log then say so.

settingsStoreUsed.description: Settings flash partition (cfgdata, 128 KB NVS): bytes in use - settings, alarms, records, rain statistics, reset history (the chart history has its own partition).

starts.description: Starts counted since the reset history began (a factory reset keeps it; erasing the flash starts it again).

resets.description: Why the node restarted, the last 10 times, newest first ([0] = this run's start).

cause.description: Reset cause (ESP-IDF reset reason): powerOn = power applied, external = reset button / EN pin, software = planned restart (detail says why), panic = crash, taskWatchdog = a task hung (120 s), interruptWatchdog = interrupts blocked, brownout = supply voltage dip, usb = reset over USB (flashing tools).

uptimeSec.description: How long the node had run before this reset: the main loop's last heartbeat (after a watchdog reset: when the loop last ran).
uptimeSec.x-present: when known (lost with the power: not after power-on)

time.description: UTC of that last heartbeat - about the time of the reset.
time.x-present: when the clock was set before the reset

detail.description: software: the restart's reason ("settings saved", "firmware update"); a crash: "<task>: <panic details or CPU exception>" (cut).

crash.description: true = lastCrash belongs to this reset.

lastCrash.x-present: after the first crash with a core dump (kept until a newer crash)
lastCrash.description: Summary of the ESP-IDF core dump the last crash left in flash. Addresses are decoded with the firmware.elf of that build (xtensa-esp32s3-elf-addr2line -pfiaC -e firmware.elf <addresses>); the whole dump is an admin download (GET /api/diag/coredump).

time.description: UTC of the crash (the last heartbeat before it).

task.description: FreeRTOS task that crashed (after a task watchdog: the task that was running, often IDLE0/1 - reason names the hung tasks).

backtrace.description: Return addresses of the crashing task, innermost first (up to 8).

backtraceCorrupted.description: The stack walk stopped at a damaged frame.

reason.description: Panic details: abort() / assert text (file, line, function), or "task watchdog: <hung tasks>".
reason.x-present: abort, assert, watchdog (a CPU exception has none: see exception)

exception.description: CPU exception (Xtensa EXCCAUSE), e.g. LoadProhibited, StoreProhibited, IllegalInstruction.

exceptionAddress.description: The address the exception was about (EXCVADDR), e.g. 0x00000000 for a null pointer.

elfSha.description: Leading hex digits of that build's ELF SHA-256 (9 with the stock build setting): which firmware.elf decodes the addresses.

coreDump.description: The full core dump is still in flash (admin download GET /api/diag/coredump).

stackFree.description: Stack of each task never used so far (FreeRTOS high-water mark, bytes) - a value near 0 is the warning before a stack overflow. Tasks: loop (24 KB, measuring / sending / setup portal), web (8 KB, web server), wxUpload (12 KB, weather networks / notifications). A task that does not run is left out.

loop.description: Loop task (24 KB): measuring, sending, setup portal.

language.description: Language setting of the web interface (parameter 57): auto = each browser's language, else fixed. The node's own pages follow it; a UI may too.

name.description: Device name as configured ("" = none set). Use it as the station title.

hostname.description: Host name for mDNS (reachable as <hostname>.local) and Wi-Fi/DHCP (the same name). The device name in lower case with other characters as '-' (at most 31), else weathernode-<last 6 MAC hex digits>.

uptimeSec.description: Seconds since the last restart (the history is cleared by a restart).

version.description: Firmware version (git describe, e.g. 2.0.0, 2.0.0-rc.3, 2.0.0-rc.3-4-gabc1234-dirty for development builds).

updateAvailable.description: A newer version found by the update check (= /api/data firmwareUpdate).
updateAvailable.x-present: update check on and a newer version found

boardFem.description: RF front end of a V4.
boardFem.x-present: V4 with a detected front end

pcbRev.description: Board type (= /api/data status.pcbRev): 20 = V4 Full (formerly "V4 Full"), 21 = V4 Light (no I/O block: heater, fan, tacho, AUX, UV, VE.Direct), 0 = Heltec V4 without PCB (no revision ID on GPIO15); 12, 13 = Rev 1.2 / 1.3 (V3 boards, firmware 2.x only).

bme280Pins.description: GPIOs (SDA, SCL) of the BME280 bus in use: [41, 42] on a V4 Full / V4 Light; [47, 48] on a V4 without PCB, [41, 42] there only for old wiring found while GNSS is off (bme280OldPins). Also when no BME280 answers (the pins it is expected on).

bme280OldPins.description: true = V4 without PCB with the BME280 on the old pins 41/42: works, but must move to 47/48 before a GNSS module is used.

gnss.x-present: GNSS module switched on (V4 without PCB)
gnss.description: GNSS module on the V4's GNSS connector (Settings → Sensors → GNSS module).

seen.description: A valid NMEA sentence within the last 5 s.

baud.description: UART rate in use (while searching: the one being tried).

fix.description: RMC status A or GGA fix quality >= 1 within the last 3 s.

fixQuality.description: GGA fix quality: 0 none, 1 GPS, 2 DGPS, 4/5 RTK, 6 dead reckoning.

hdop.description: Horizontal dilution of precision (GGA). Position / altitude are taken over only at <= 2.

lat.description: Latitude of the last fix, decimal degrees (north positive).
lat.x-present: a fix with a position since the start, and only for a request with a valid admin login (Digest) - the station position is private; without a login the field is left out

lon.description: Longitude of the last fix, decimal degrees (east positive).
lon.x-present: a fix with a position since the start, and only for a request with a valid admin login (Digest) - the station position is private; without a login the field is left out

altitudeM.description: Altitude above mean sea level of the last fix (GGA).
altitudeM.x-present: a fix with an altitude since the start

pps.description: A PPS edge on GPIO41 within the last 2 s.

timeAgeSec.description: Seconds since the clock last took (or confirmed) the GNSS time.
timeAgeSec.x-present: the GNSS time was used since the start

timePps.description: That time was timestamped with the PPS edge (about 20 ms) rather than the NMEA line (about 1 s).
timePps.x-present: the GNSS time was used since the start

takeTime.description: Setting: the clock takes the GNSS time (source gnss, the best one).

takePosition.description: Setting: latitude / longitude follow the 5-min mean when it moved more than 100 m.

takeAltitude.description: Setting: the station altitude (sea-level pressure) follows the 5-min mean when it differs by more than 5 m.

units.description: Units of every value in /api/data, /api/history and MQTT — always present, also when /api/data has no sibling unit field (e.g. rfSensors[] without a temperature source).

temp.description: Temperatures (temp, dewPoint, feelsLike, ds18b20, cpuTemp, rfSensors[].temp).

rain.description: Rain amounts (rain, rain1h … rainYear, rfSensors[].rainTotal, history rainMm).

cycleSec.description: Measurement (base) cycle: /api/data changes once per cycle. Default 300.

windSampleSec.description: Wind sample interval of the board anemometer.

mqttWindAggregation.description: Wind window of the MQTT payload: the MQTT interval, or the WMO 10-min mean. /api/data always uses the base cycle.

clockSynced.description: NTP time has been received since the start; without it rainToday … rainYear, lastRain and sunshine are absent.

timeZone.description: Device time zone as POSIX TZ string (defines 'today' for rainToday etc.).

clockSource.description: Time source the clock follows (the last one that set or confirmed it): gnss (GNSS module, V4 without PCB), ntp, dcf77 (radio-clock time of a WH31 / WN31 DNT sensor), phone (a browser time, POST /api/time), lorawan (DeviceTimeReq). Priority gnss > ntp > dcf77 > phone > lorawan; a worse source never overrides a fresh better one. none = no time since the start.

clockSourceAgeSec.description: Seconds since clockSource last delivered a time.

clockSourceFresh.description: clockSource is within its freshness window (gnss 1 h, ntp 24 h, dcf77 25 h, phone 24 h, lorawan 24 h); false = the clock runs on its own since then.

loraTimeReqInSec.description: Next LoRaWAN DeviceTimeReq in seconds (0 = with the next uplink). Absent when LoRaWAN is not joined or a better source (NTP ...) is fresh.
loraTimeReqInSec.x-present: LoRaWAN joined, no better fresh time source

history.description: History served by /api/history: the ranges (at end = now) and the tiers behind them.

range.description: Value of the range query parameter.

bucketSec.description: Length of one point (tier bucket x buckets merged per point).

maxPoints.description: Most finished points the range returns (plus one open bucket; one more where merged points do not line up with the window).

res.description: Tier that serves the range at end = now.

tiers.description: The stored tiers; capacity x bucketSec is how far back a tier reaches (for the end parameter).

res.description: Value of the res query parameter.

outputs.description: Enabled outputs/integrations — on/off only, no addresses or credentials.

webApi.description: Web interface/REST API enabled (true whenever you can read this).

mqtt.description: MQTT publishing enabled (same JSON as /api/data on <prefix>/data).

influxdb.description: InfluxDB / VictoriaMetrics push enabled (Wi-Fi on, push on, write URL set).

accessPoint.description: Own Wi-Fi access point (docs/settings.md#own-access-point): off, fallback (opens while the Wi-Fi network is unreachable) or always; off while Wi-Fi or the web interface is off.

accessPointActive.description: The own access point runs now (its name and password are never listed).

accessPointClients.description: Devices connected to the own access point (updated every 2 s, at most 8).

https.description: HTTPS on port 443 (Settings -> System -> HTTPS): off (not enabled, the default), on (running), or why it does not run - waitingForNetwork (no usable uploaded certificate, and the generated one waits for the station's Wi-Fi address), generateFailed (generating a self-signed certificate failed), lowMemory, startFailed. In every case but on the web interface runs on plain HTTP without redirects.

httpsCertificate.description: Whose certificate HTTPS runs with: the admin's uploaded one, or the self-signed one the node generated (docs/settings.md#https).

weatherNetworks.description: Weather networks the node uploads to.

status.x-present: always; one entry per enabled output
status.description: Send status per enabled output since start: last success / error as age, the last error's short text (local reason or trimmed server reply - never URLs or keys) and code, consecutive failures. haDiscovery = the Home Assistant discovery configs (MQTT).

wow.description: Send status of Met Office WOW.

ntfy.description: Send status of alarm notifications via ntfy.

pushover.description: Send status of alarm notifications via Pushover.

telegram.description: Send status of alarm notifications via Telegram.

webhook.description: Send status of the alarm webhook.

influxdb.description: Send status of the InfluxDB / VictoriaMetrics push, with its backfill queue.

available.description: Value groups /api/data currently carries — build your tiles from this. Can change at run time (e.g. a wireless sensor goes silent); /api/data presence is authoritative per cycle.

pressure.description: pressureAbs/pressureQnh from the selected pressure source (BME280 or a wireless sensor).

ds18b20Probes.description: Number of DS18B20 probe slots (length of /api/data ds18b20).

wirelessSensors.description: Wireless reception on: rfSensors, sources, radioBatteryLow.

wireless.description: Wireless sensor states (settings: Mine / Received / Hidden).

onlyMine.description: Only the "Mine" sensors are accepted (setting Only my sensors, with a non-empty list).

mine.description: IDs in the "Mine" list (numbered first, wireless 1..n; Home Assistant devices).

hidden.description: IDs in the hidden list (never stored, numbered or output).

hiddenInRange.description: Hidden sensors heard within the last 10 minutes.

virtualSensors.x-present: the setting Send virtual sensors is on
virtualSensors.description: Virtual sensors (docs/virtual-sensors.md): the node's own values sent as Fine Offset (Ecowitt) sensor frames on 868.3 MHz. Never carries frame bytes.

txPowerDbm.description: Configured transmit power at the antenna, dBm.

airtimeLastHourMs.description: The node's airtime in the 868.0-868.6 MHz band in the last hour (virtual sensors + LoRaWAN uplinks), ms.

airtimeBudgetMs.description: Airtime allowed per hour in that band (1 % = 36000 ms); a frame that would exceed it is skipped.

davisGapFrames.description: Frames sent in the gap after a Davis packet since start (all slots).

davisGapMaxMs.description: Longest gap use measured: from the first frame's transmit setup until Davis reception runs again on the next hop channel, ms.

id.description: The sensor's table ID as a receiving node shows it (family code + ID; WH31 with the channel). Derived from the node's MAC and the slot, never configurable.

fields.description: Frame field -> value name (placeholder name in the stored form, e.g. temp, @L3F9A2C_temp, ds1, rain_total); only mapped fields.

lastTxSecAgo.description: Seconds since the last frame was sent.

idReceived.description: true = a received sensor in range has the same ID (WH31 IDs have 8 bits); the ID stays stable — use another slot or type.

skipped.description: Frames not sent since start, by reason.

airtime.description: The hourly airtime budget was used up.

radioBusy.description: A firmware upload ran, or the transmit failed.

valueMissing.description: A needed value was not available.

deferredDavis.description: Davis mode: the frame found no gap after a Davis packet before the slot's next frame (missed hop, prediction not locked) and was replaced or dropped.

lastError.description: RadioLib error code of the last failed transmit.

sources.description: Current source per value group (same format as /api/data sources, but always present).

lastOkSecAgo.description: Seconds since the last success (absent: none since start).

lastErrorSecAgo.description: Seconds since the last error (absent: none since start).

lastError.description: Last error: local reason or trimmed server reply.

lastErrorCode.description: Code of the last error: HTTP status, negative HTTP client / RadioLib code, or the MQTT client state.

influxStatus.description: Send status of the InfluxDB push (fields as outStatus) plus the backfill queue.

lastOkSecAgo.description: Seconds since the last accepted request (absent: none since start).

lastErrorSecAgo.description: Seconds since the last error (absent: none since start).

lastError.description: Last error: local reason or trimmed server reply.

lastErrorCode.description: HTTP status or negative HTTP client code of the last error.

backlog.x-present: when the queue's PSRAM ring is allocated (push on)
backlog.description: Pushes not yet accepted by the database (RAM only, lost on a restart); sent oldest first with their original timestamps.

pushes.description: Queued pushes (one per interval; 1 normally while it is being sent).

oldestSecAgo.description: Age of the oldest queued push (absent: empty).

droppedFull.description: Pushes dropped since start because the ring was full (oldest first).

droppedRejected.description: Pushes dropped since start because the database refused them (4xx other than 401/403/404/408/429).
